							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Meeting documents & recordings</h1>

<p>General monthly Council meetings are known as 'ordinary meetings'. They are held 11 times per year, from February to December. </p>
<p>Councillors and senior staff attend these meetings with staff providing briefings on agenda items beforehand. </p>
<p>The monthly meetings rotate between Coleambally, Darlington Point and Jerilderie.</p>
<p>Members of the community are welcome to attend in person and observe from the public gallery.</p>
<p>Each meeting has an agenda and business paper (which includes reports and related attachments). These documents are available from Council offices and our website the Thursday before the meeting date.</p>
<p>Members of the community are welcome to attend the meetings in person and observe from the public gallery. All meetings are live streamed on the Murrumbidgee Council <a href="https://www.facebook.com/MRMbge/" title="Murrumbidgee Council Facebook page">Facebook</a> page.</p>
<p><span style="font-family: inherit; font-size: 1em;">Following the meeting, the minutes are uploaded to our website.</span></p>
<p>A recording of each meeting is also uploaded to our website and the Murrumbidgee Council <a href="https://www.youtube.com/@murrumbidgeecouncil9285" title="Murrumbidgee Council YouTube page">YouTube</a> page.</p>

    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();
    </script>

                            <!-- OC Layout Element Conent Template -->
							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Meeting documents & recordings</h1>

<p>General monthly Council meetings are known as 'ordinary meetings'. They are held 11 times per year, from February to December. </p>
<p>Councillors and senior staff attend these meetings with staff providing briefings on agenda items beforehand. </p>
<p>The monthly meetings rotate between Coleambally, Darlington Point and Jerilderie.</p>
<p>Members of the community are welcome to attend in person and observe from the public gallery.</p>
<p>Each meeting has an agenda and business paper (which includes reports and related attachments). These documents are available from Council offices and our website the Thursday before the meeting date.</p>
<p>Members of the community are welcome to attend the meetings in person and observe from the public gallery. All meetings are live streamed on the Murrumbidgee Council <a href="https://www.facebook.com/MRMbge/" title="Murrumbidgee Council Facebook page">Facebook</a> page.</p>
<p><span style="font-family: inherit; font-size: 1em;">Following the meeting, the minutes are uploaded to our website.</span></p>
<p>A recording of each meeting is also uploaded to our website and the Murrumbidgee Council <a href="https://www.youtube.com/@murrumbidgeecouncil9285" title="Murrumbidgee Council YouTube page">YouTube</a> page.</p>

    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();
    </script>

                            <!-- OC Layout Element Conent Template -->
							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Meeting documents & recordings</h1>

<p>General monthly Council meetings are known as 'ordinary meetings'. They are held 11 times per year, from February to December. </p>
<p>Councillors and senior staff attend these meetings with staff providing briefings on agenda items beforehand. </p>
<p>The monthly meetings rotate between Coleambally, Darlington Point and Jerilderie.</p>
<p>Members of the community are welcome to attend in person and observe from the public gallery.</p>
<p>Each meeting has an agenda and business paper (which includes reports and related attachments). These documents are available from Council offices and our website the Thursday before the meeting date.</p>
<p>Members of the community are welcome to attend the meetings in person and observe from the public gallery. All meetings are live streamed on the Murrumbidgee Council <a href="https://www.facebook.com/MRMbge/" title="Murrumbidgee Council Facebook page">Facebook</a> page.</p>
<p><span style="font-family: inherit; font-size: 1em;">Following the meeting, the minutes are uploaded to our website.</span></p>
<p>A recording of each meeting is also uploaded to our website and the Murrumbidgee Council <a href="https://www.youtube.com/@murrumbidgeecouncil9285" title="Murrumbidgee Council YouTube page">YouTube</a> page.</p>

        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();

							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Meeting documents & recordings</h1>

<p>General monthly Council meetings are known as 'ordinary meetings'. They are held 11 times per year, from February to December. </p>
<p>Councillors and senior staff attend these meetings with staff providing briefings on agenda items beforehand. </p>
<p>The monthly meetings rotate between Coleambally, Darlington Point and Jerilderie.</p>
<p>Members of the community are welcome to attend in person and observe from the public gallery.</p>
<p>Each meeting has an agenda and business paper (which includes reports and related attachments). These documents are available from Council offices and our website the Thursday before the meeting date.</p>
<p>Members of the community are welcome to attend the meetings in person and observe from the public gallery. All meetings are live streamed on the Murrumbidgee Council <a href="https://www.facebook.com/MRMbge/" title="Murrumbidgee Council Facebook page">Facebook</a> page.</p>
<p><span style="font-family: inherit; font-size: 1em;">Following the meeting, the minutes are uploaded to our website.</span></p>
<p>A recording of each meeting is also uploaded to our website and the Murrumbidgee Council <a href="https://www.youtube.com/@murrumbidgeecouncil9285" title="Murrumbidgee Council YouTube page">YouTube</a> page.</p>

							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Meeting documents & recordings</h1>

<p>General monthly Council meetings are known as 'ordinary meetings'. They are held 11 times per year, from February to December. </p>
<p>Councillors and senior staff attend these meetings with staff providing briefings on agenda items beforehand. </p>
<p>The monthly meetings rotate between Coleambally, Darlington Point and Jerilderie.</p>
<p>Members of the community are welcome to attend in person and observe from the public gallery.</p>
<p>Each meeting has an agenda and business paper (which includes reports and related attachments). These documents are available from Council offices and our website the Thursday before the meeting date.</p>
<p>Members of the community are welcome to attend the meetings in person and observe from the public gallery. All meetings are live streamed on the Murrumbidgee Council <a href="https://www.facebook.com/MRMbge/" title="Murrumbidgee Council Facebook page">Facebook</a> page.</p>
<p><span style="font-family: inherit; font-size: 1em;">Following the meeting, the minutes are uploaded to our website.</span></p>
<p>A recording of each meeting is also uploaded to our website and the Murrumbidgee Council <a href="https://www.youtube.com/@murrumbidgeecouncil9285" title="Murrumbidgee Council YouTube page">YouTube</a> page.</p>

							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Meeting documents & recordings</h1>

<p>General monthly Council meetings are known as 'ordinary meetings'. They are held 11 times per year, from February to December. </p>
<p>Councillors and senior staff attend these meetings with staff providing briefings on agenda items beforehand. </p>
<p>The monthly meetings rotate between Coleambally, Darlington Point and Jerilderie.</p>
<p>Members of the community are welcome to attend in person and observe from the public gallery.</p>
<p>Each meeting has an agenda and business paper (which includes reports and related attachments). These documents are available from Council offices and our website the Thursday before the meeting date.</p>
<p>Members of the community are welcome to attend the meetings in person and observe from the public gallery. All meetings are live streamed on the Murrumbidgee Council <a href="https://www.facebook.com/MRMbge/" title="Murrumbidgee Council Facebook page">Facebook</a> page.</p>
<p><span style="font-family: inherit; font-size: 1em;">Following the meeting, the minutes are uploaded to our website.</span></p>
<p>A recording of each meeting is also uploaded to our website and the Murrumbidgee Council <a href="https://www.youtube.com/@murrumbidgeecouncil9285" title="Murrumbidgee Council YouTube page">YouTube</a> page.</p>
